source: CR-34 One upload inbox, rev 2 (prompt attached Nov 15, 2026)
routesNote: CR-34 rev 2 as given doesn't list its routes; none are assumed or called. The prototype needs: create an upload (resumable), list the inbox, file an inbox item to destinations, discard, get a file with versions, links, readers and receipts, upload a new version, unlink, purge with a reason.
